claim: AWS Managed Microsoft AD supports one-way and two-way external and forest trusts with self-managed (on-premises) directories and with other AWS Managed Microsoft AD directories, in all three directions: incoming, outgoing and two-way.
question: Which trust relationships can AWS Managed Microsoft AD create with a self-managed Active Directory?

values.display: one and two-way external and forest trust relationships

evidence.quote: You can configure one and two-way external and forest trust relationships between your AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory and self-managed (on-premises) directories, as well as between multiple AWS Managed Microsoft AD directories in the AWS cloud. AWS Managed Microsoft AD supports all three trust relationship directions: Incoming, Outgoing and Two-way (Bi-directional).

claim: A two-way trust is required for AWS enterprise apps such as IAM Identity Center, WorkSpaces, Amazon Quick, WorkMail and the AWS Management Console, because AWS Managed Microsoft AD must query users and groups in the self-managed AD; Amazon EC2, Amazon RDS and Amazon FSx work with either a one-way or a two-way trust.
question: Which AWS services need a two-way trust between AWS Managed Microsoft AD and an on-premises AD, and which work with a one-way trust?

values.display: A two-way trust is required for AWS Enterprise Apps
either a one-way or two-way trust

qualifiers.scope: trusts between AWS Managed Microsoft AD and a self-managed AD

evidence.quote: A two-way trust is required for AWS Enterprise Apps such as Amazon Chime, Connect Customer, Quick, AWS IAM Identity Center, WorkDocs, Amazon WorkMail, Amazon WorkSpaces, and the AWS Management Console. AWS Managed Microsoft AD must be able to query the users and groups in your self-managed Active Directory.
Amazon EC2, Amazon RDS, and Amazon FSx will work with either a one-way or two-way trust.

claim: Before creating a trust with a self-managed directory, the self-managed network must be connected to the VPC that contains AWS Managed Microsoft AD, with the required Active Directory ports open on both firewalls, and DNS conditional forwarders must be set up on the self-managed domain.
question: What network setup does a trust between AWS Managed Microsoft AD and an on-premises AD need?

values.display: connect your self-managed network to the Amazon VPC

qualifiers.scope: trusts between AWS Managed Microsoft AD and a self-managed AD

evidence.quote: If you are creating a trust relationship with your self-managed directory, you must first connect your self-managed network to the Amazon VPC containing your AWS Managed Microsoft AD.
You must set up DNS conditional forwarders on your self-managed domain.
